verdict.rationale: Databricks documents in-product AI insight features. Genie answers natural-language data questions grounded in the organization's data and returns SQL, results tables, and visualizations. AI/BI dashboards add AI-assisted authoring for sharing insights, and Genie Code offers inline suggestions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and evidence of proactive (unprompted) AI-generated data insights rather than question-driven answers; the 'automatic insights' doc concerns query performance, not data content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask data questions in natural language and get answers grounded in your organization's data.
users ask questions of their data and get back SQL queries, results tables, and visualizations
Create interactive AI/BI dashboards with AI-assisted authoring to share insights across your organization.
Chat with Genie Code, get inline suggestions, and run agentic tasks in your workspace.
